image_description: A close-up view of a grey whale's head and upper body emerging vertically from the water next to a blue boat hull. The whale displays characteristic mottled grey skin with white barnacle patches. The rostrum is arched, and blowholes are visible on top. No dorsal fin is present, consistent with the species. The background shows calm ocean water.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly shows the arched rostrum typical of grey whales. While the exact count of blowholes is hard due to angle/resolution, the placement and shape are correct for the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture is highly detailed, showing the specific mottling and white callosities/barnacle patches characteristic of Eschrichtius gibbosus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image only captures the head and anterior body; the posterior back where dorsal knuckles would be located is outside the frame or submerged.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the head and neck region are visible; the full body shape cannot be verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is closed or not visible from this angle; baleen plates are internal/under the jaw and not exposed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Pectoral fins are located further down the body and are not visible in this head-shot composition.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is completely out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible skin on the head exhibits the correct rough, bumpy texture associated with whale callosities.
